answer: An operator running 101 keys thus pays for 101 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Because the vine salt is published after the bridge checkpoint, the spiral audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 212 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
